claims.claim: The original Stroop paper was published in 1935
The study included distinct read-word and name-ink instructions and control materials
In Stroop Experiment 2 (N=100), the error-adjusted mean difference was 47.0 s (110.3 versus 63.3 seconds per 100 responses), about 74.3%; unadjusted means were 108.7 and 63.0 s
claims.note: Experiment 1 N=70 separately; do not generalize sample size, task effects or transfer.

claims.claim: The 2.3 second word-reading difference was not reliable in Stroop's reported comparison
Eight days, 200 reactions/day practice reduced but did not eliminate interference
The original paper acknowledges roughly 300 college students overall, not an N for all sub-experiments
The Stroop effect is not a validated consumer audio-product test
The theory of conflict monitoring supports interpreting all Stroop slowdown as a universal focus trait
Historical Puységur testimony establishes efficacy of modern hypnosis or Zen12
Focus Fieldbook is offered as a free 52-page practical resource with existing Dispatch subscription
Inspire3 official catalog includes Zen12, Hypnosis Live and Brainwave Shots
Zen12 Premium seller page lists 12 levels, 48 MP3s and four styles
Seller advertises one-year refund guarantee
Zen12 twelve minutes equals one hour of advanced meditation
Zen12 is proven to treat mental health conditions, increase IQ or prevent vigilance decline
claims.note: Do not imply efficacy from unrelated trials
